text:
nik: Quick RFC follow-up on dedicated GPU pool autoscaling. Need a crisp boundary between SLA-weighted admission and generic burst admission. Proposal: add a tiny policy evaluator that enforces per-tenant SLA bands (token-buckets) and delegates capacity changes to the existing autoscaler; no second active control loop.

maria: thin evaluator = admission gate + counters only? agree we should avoid adding another scaler.

sam: token-bucket per tenant sounds good. Keep evaluator stateless/pure so we can dry-run decisions.

lee: when the SLA bucket drains tenants want options: soft reject with retry guidance, or auto-fallback to cheaper model variants (tenant opt-in). Both need to be configurable.

nik: sketch of policy (human readable):
```
sla_weight: 0.65
token_bucket_capacity: 1000
token_refill_per_min: 300
fallbacks:
  - gptx-s-8q
  - gptx-2b-int8
```
Add adaptive refill hooked to observed p95 (EWMA over 60s) with a min refill floor to prevent oscillation.

maria: adaptive refill OK but tune smoothing and floor. Also add a burn-rate forecast metric so Console can show when a tenant will hit depletion.

sam: lean to running the evaluator as a control-plane proxy (not in the runtime path) so we can dry-run, emit audit logs, and HA it independently.

lee: ops requirement: emit "sla_band_depleted" events and metric tags (tenant_id, action, fallback_used) so SRE can alert.

infra-bot: Deploy note: autoscaler-proxy v0.9 canaryed in cluster-b.

nik: testing plan: build a sim harness that replays historical traces and runs the evaluator in dry-run mode. The sim should output per-tenant CSV with: rejections, fallback_invocations, tokens_consumed, est_cost_delta, p95_change.

maria: I can prototype the sim harness this week. Will ensure policy evaluator is pure so dry-run matches live decisions.

sam: I'll prototype the control-plane proxy API and a compact YAML policy schema.

lee: I'll define metrics, tags, and the 429 error payload shape: include Retry-After and X-Redwood-Fallback-URL when fallbacks are available; also return a short machine-readable code so SDKs can special-case.

nik: rollout plan: (1) implement evaluator + sim, (2) ship proxy in canary with dry-run for 7d, (3) enable enforcement for a small set of tenants (<5), (4) expand and add fallback variants after validation.

maria: who owns what: I9ll take sim + CSV report.

sam: proxy API + policy schema prototype.

lee: metrics + 429 payload docs and mock dashboards.

nik: logging: decisions go to an ndjson audit stream forwarded to Kafka topic `sla-policy-decisions.v1`. Infra approved the topic.

infra-bot: Notice: topic `sla-policy-decisions.v1` created with retention 14d.

nik: follow-ups: post PR links for sim, proxy sketch, and metrics. thanks all :raised_hands:
